nodes.label: Generate the secrets the self-hosted Supabase stack needs. Hosted Supabase…
nodes.norm_label: generate the secrets the self-hosted supabase stack needs. hosted supabase...

nodes.label: JWTs use base64url with the padding stripped.
nodes.norm_label: jwts use base64url with the padding stripped.

nodes.label: GoTrue auth service
nodes.rationale: The piece plain Postgres cannot give: magic links, Google OAuth, auth schema

nodes.label: avernek-supabase-db (supabase/postgres)
nodes.rationale: supabase/postgres ships roles and extensions that Auth, PostgREST and RLS policies assume; loopback port 5433 avoids host Postgres collision

nodes.label: PostgREST
nodes.rationale: Assumes JWT role so existing RLS policies apply unchanged

nodes.label: Supabase Studio
nodes.rationale: No login of its own; must be behind Caddy basic auth

nodes.label: SITE_URL / Redirect Allow List
nodes.rationale: Fallback for redirects not in allow list - the setting that bounced sign-ins to Netlify

nodes.label: SMTP Mailer Config
nodes.rationale: Hosted Supabase lent a shared mailer; self-hosted magic links do not send without SMTP

nodes.label: Caddy Reverse Proxy
nodes.rationale: Replaces Kong: handle_path strips /auth/v1 and /rest/v1 prefixes under one origin

nodes.label: ADDITIONAL_REDIRECT_URLS Allow List
nodes.rationale: Now version-controllable config instead of web UI

nodes.label: Reduced Supabase Stack
nodes.rationale: App uses only Postgres, Auth, PostgREST; Storage, Realtime, imgproxy, Functions, Analytics, Kong omitted - fewer containers to break/patch

nodes.label: CORS Header Handling
nodes.rationale: Never duplicate Access-Control-Allow-Origin already sent upstream

nodes.label: Studio Basic Auth
nodes.rationale: Studio has no login; anyone who reaches it has full DB access

nodes.label: Loopback Port + Reverse Proxy
nodes.rationale: Publish to 127.0.0.1:APP_PORT only; nginx/Caddy terminates TLS

nodes.label: ANON_KEY / SERVICE_ROLE_KEY JWTs
nodes.rationale: HS256 JWTs signed with JWT_SECRET differing only in role claim; PostgREST assumes role so RLS applies

nodes.label: avernek-postgres (postgres:16-alpine)
nodes.rationale: No host port published so only compose network reaches it; avoids collision with n8n Postgres

nodes.label: avernek-fx-cron sidecar
nodes.rationale: Replaces Netlify Scheduled Function so NRB rate logic keeps a single source of truth

nodes.label: avernek-expense-tracker web service
nodes.rationale: All runtime values (DATABASE_URL, SESSION_SECRET, ADMIN_*, CRON_SECRET) via env_file; nothing baked into image

nodes.label: Nepal Rastra Bank Sell Rate
nodes.rationale: NRB sell rate used; most recent rate on or before expense date, never a future rate; real date stored in fx_rate_date

nodes.label: Off-box Backup Retention
nodes.rationale: Same-disk dump does not survive losing server

nodes.label: Frozen Historical Exchange Rate
nodes.rationale: amount_npr never changes because today's rate moved; historical accuracy

nodes.label: Money Rules
nodes.rationale: All monetary columns Postgres numeric, never float; never add raw USD to raw NPR; pending excluded from totals

nodes.label: USD Three-Tier NPR Valuation Rule
nodes.rationale: exact > official_estimate (frozen) > manual_estimate > pending, so estimates never masquerade as confirmed figures

nodes.label: Owner-Only Modification Policy
nodes.rationale: Team members may view and add; only the owner account may modify/delete records or protected settings

nodes.label: Mandatory Rebuild for NEXT_PUBLIC_*
nodes.rationale: NEXT_PUBLIC_* inlined at build time; restart insufficient

nodes.label: Smoke Test Auto-Rollback
nodes.rationale: If /api/health fails within ~60s redeploy previous tag; last 5 images kept

nodes.label: DOCKER_BUILD Standalone Gate
nodes.rationale: Standalone output gated behind DOCKER_BUILD=1 so Netlify keeps working unchanged

nodes.label: Build-time vs Runtime Secrets Flow
nodes.rationale: NEXT_PUBLIC_* inlined at build so mounted as BuildKit secret on tmpfs; server-only keys injected at runtime; .env never enters an image layer

nodes.label: Auth Users Stable-Column Copy
nodes.rationale: Cloud GoTrue version may differ; dump only stable columns, not whole auth schema

nodes.label: Migration from Supabase Cloud
nodes.rationale: Restore public first, then auth.users; on_auth_user_created trigger's on conflict do nothing makes auth insert a no-op

nodes.label: Orphaned Expenses Verification
nodes.rationale: orphaned must be 0 or ID mapping broke
